$comment: The Antigravity models the window's pickers offer, each with the levels `agy` accepts for `--effort` (null: the model takes no effort). agentSelection.ts reads this file for the pickers; live_antigravity_model_table_matches_the_cli_model_list (desktop/src-tauri/src/antigravity_models.rs) compares it with `agy --output-format json models`, so a model Google adds, retires or re-levels fails `make test-live-antigravity`. Matches agy 1.4.2 (2026-10-19). Labels drop agy's `Claude ` prefix; see MODEL_OPTIONS in agentSelection.ts.
